issue.why_categorical: the spec's per-plan done rule and TASK-3's listing scope differ from what plan V6 and the code do
issue.why_free_form: progress.ts falls back to an item's own status for each item without a usable receipt, where harness status_view counts a receipts-scheme plan's item with no receipt as PENDING; the scan reads receipts for any qualifying plan whatever its frozen.records scheme, where harness book_for reads them only for receipts plans; a plan id shared by two plan files is never listed, since a receipt's owner file is unknown

new_outcome.indicated: V6 stands: the receipt-else-status fallback applies per item, receipts count for any qualifying plan, and a plan id shared by two plan files counts its item statuses; progress.ts, mirror.ts and the README state the divergence from status_view and book_for. Receipts plans keep their items PENDING, so the divergence shows only on hand-made states

why_new_outcome.free_form: matching the harness rule would change V6 and need a refreeze for a case receipts plans do not produce; documenting the divergence keeps the plan as written
